segments.title: Chương 39: 0039
segments.content:
Imperial Capital.

Fu Guoqiang wolfed down his dinner, reminded his son to do his homework, then slipped into the study to wait for the game server to open.

His wife, a civil servant, had a grim look on her face. After watching the evening news, she chased him into the study: "Fu Guoqiang, just look at yourself. You're a grown man, cooped up at home playing computer games all day. Aren't you ashamed?"

"Just for a bit, it won't get in the way of anything," Fu Guoqiang said as he contacted his friends on QQ.

"Drop dead in there for all I care!"

"Bang!"

The door was slammed shut.

Fu Guoqiang pursed his lips, deciding not to stoop to his wife's level. After a thought, he went out and asked the nanny to make him a cup of tea. He was planning to pull an all-nighter with his bros.

Women are good at asking poor devils for money and rich bros for time. Back at his computer, Fu Guoqiang continued chatting on QQ:

"Who's not here yet?"

"Yongzi has something urgent, can't make it tonight."

"That son of a bitch, always got a hundred excuses like a lazy mule."

"I've finished downloading the game and just tried to log in. Can't get in the game, but I can create a character. This crappy private server actually has five zones."

"Five zones right from the start?"

"Each zone can hold a thousand people. You guys should check the forum posts."

"I'll go take a look."

Downstairs from the game studio, Tao Chenggang had rented another residential flat.

There was no time to renovate; it still had the landlord's bed, table, chairs, and wardrobe.

This was the command center for Abyss Legend!

The computers were well-configured, each one assembled by Feng Tao and his apprentices.

"What do we do?"

Watching the constantly rising number of game downloads, beads of sweat had begun to form on Tao Chenggang's forehead.

Although it was still less than 1500 downloads, the growth rate was too fast.

"Let's put out another disclaimer."

Chen Guiliang sat down at the computer himself. Using the "I" account from the promotional articles, he updated the "Private Server Dev Log" one last time:

"Thank you, brothers and sisters, for your support. A Sword Comes West and I have boldly adopted many of your valuable suggestions. 'Abyss Server' is the child of all of us. We've watched it grow from nothing, and tonight it will be born into the world. We hope it can grow strong and healthy..."

"The server we rented can accommodate a full 5000 people online at the same time. Haha, with such a large server capacity, it's surely more than enough. I'm so awesome!"

Tao Chenggang read the post. "That's it?"

Chen Guiliang stood up and said, "Brother Yang, have your guys reply to the post. Seventy percent of the replies should be mocking, saying 5000 concurrent players is wishful thinking. The remaining thirty percent should flame the other seventy percent."

"What's the point of that?" Xie Yang asked curiously.

Chen Guiliang said, "If the server has space, it's pointless. If the server is maxed out, then there are follow-up actions."

Before his voice had faded, Yang Yuhui swallowed and said, "The total downloads from the major game forums has already surpassed 1600. It's climbing so fast!"

Chen Guiliang said, "It's only 7:40 right now. The office workers in the big cities have just gotten home. If their internet is slow, they probably haven't even finished downloading yet. Who knows how many people are downloading right now."

"This is illogical. No matter how successful the promotion is, it's impossible to break 5000 concurrent players, right?" Tao Chenggang said.

Chen Guiliang couldn't figure it out either.

"Bang bang bang, bang bang bang!"

Someone was pounding on the door from outside, yelling anxiously, "Something big has happened, something big has happened!"

Xie Yang, ever so perceptive, rushed to open the door.

The person in charge of the studio, arranged by Yang Yuhui, stood at the door and said quickly, "A lot of players in Legend of Mir are planning to come play the private server together!"

"Explain the situation clearly. When did this start?" Chen Guiliang asked hurriedly.

The person said, "While we were gold farming in the game, we noticed people talking about a private server a few days ago. Some were even shouting in the public channel, cursing Shanda on one hand and calling for people to play Abyss Legend on the other. A lot of players probably planned this long ago, but they were just talking privately without making a big fuss. After 7:30 tonight, the safe zones in all of Legend of Mir's servers are filled with people shouting about going to play the private server!"

Chen Guiliang and Tao Chenggang exchanged a look, already understanding what had gone wrong.

Although Legend of Mir had lost many players, it still maintained hundreds of thousands online and could still win first place in the most popular game awards next year.

However, the game hadn't been updated in half a year, and most players were long tired of it.

They had accumulated resentment and anger towards Shanda but were reluctant to leave, so they had remained in the game.

And the "Legend Refugee Post" that Chen Guiliang had created resonated with a large number of official server players. The resentment and anger in their hearts seemed to find an outlet all at once, and they flocked to the game forums to read the posts.

Many people only read the posts without replying, but quietly invited their friends to play the private server.

Their reasoning was easy to understand: first, to reminisce about the old days; second, to try something new on a private server; third, to deliberately get back at Shanda; and fourth, to follow the trend and join the fun.

There was an especially large number of those seeking revenge on Shanda.

A large portion of them were likely unwilling to pay for dungeons and might even leave after playing for ten or twenty minutes.

But the influx of a massive number of players would inevitably crash the server!

Without needing Shanda's hackers, enthusiastic netizens alone could lag Abyss Legend to death.

Yang Yuhui suddenly stood up, turned to the crowd, and said, "More than a dozen internet cafe managers have added me on QQ, saying that the official Legend players in their cafes are asking if our private server is installed on the computers. These managers want to cooperate with us and are asking about the commission for top-ups."

"The maximum is no more than 20%, try to negotiate it down as low as possible."

Tao Chenggang picked up his phone and walked to the corridor. "I'll make a call, see if we can rent a server urgently."

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He had been in the game industry in his past life but never expected to see a day when he was afraid of having too many players.

Fu Guoqiang had already taken out his bank card and opened the online banking page.

As long as this private server was fun, he would pour money into it to show his support.

This Beijing gentleman was not short of cash!

Moreover, "A Sword Comes West" had posted about an alternative top-up method, which made Fu Guoqiang very curious and full of anticipation.

"Go, go, go! Time's up, everyone get into Zone 1!"

Fu Guoqiang typed quickly on QQ.

After logging into the game, Fu Guoqiang switched to the QQ interface: "I spawned in Bicheon Village. Report your positions."

The six old Legend brothers reported their coordinates to each other and agreed to meet up at a certain spot.

The novice village was bustling at this moment.

Dense crowds of players ran around, stark naked. Their first priority wasn't to kill monsters and level up, but to shout and chat in the public channel.

"Haha, I'm in the private server. Shanda can go to hell!"

"Chen XX, I x your mother!"

"As long as Shanda doesn't update, I'm not playing the official server for a day."

"Update my ass, I've been waiting for over half a year."

"Any old players from Blaze? Come on and team up!"

"Looking for MM, any girls around?"

"..."

Fu Guoqiang chuckled looking at the chat box. This was some atmosphere.

He controlled his warrior character, first teaming up with the brothers in Bicheon Village, then set off, hacking at monsters along the way.

The leveling speed of this private server was about five times that of the official Legend.

"Damn, this Rake Cat is fierce!"

"It must be a mutated monster infected by the void power."

"Get it, get it!"

"Crap, I died."

"Hahaha, just like when we first started playing Legend, actually getting killed by a Rake Cat."

"..."

Fu Guoqiang saw his old friend get killed by a small mob and burst out laughing as he typed.

He hadn't had this much fun in a long time.

"It dropped something, it dropped something!"

"A huge drop."

"I picked up Fireball."

"Holy crap! I got an 'Abyss Iron Bracelet.' The stats are insane. Attack 3, Magic 2, Tao 2, Accuracy 2."

His friend had already equipped the bracelet. Fu Guoqiang clicked to inspect it and found that the stats were indeed insane, and it emanated a faint bloody glow.

Fu Guoqiang was thrilled and typed, "Let's level up and look for abyss mutated monsters. Be careful not to let anyone steal them, there are a lot of people playing this private server."

The brothers leveled up quickly. After some unknown amount of time, Fu Guoqiang felt the game getting laggy.

But it was still barely playable.

A wild Zombie King in the mine suddenly had a huge drop, and one of the brothers shouted, "I picked up an 'Abyss Map Teleport Scroll'!"

"What's going on?" Everyone got excited.

The person kept clicking on trade, letting all the brothers see the stats.

Fu Guoqiang also saw it soon enough—

Abyss Map Teleport Scroll: A mysterious power is invading the Marfa continent. Void projections have formed in the abyss rifts in some important areas. You can ask the Veteran for details.

This was a dungeon ticket!

Mutated monsters and bosses in normal maps had an extremely low chance of dropping it, leaving a way for free-to-play players.

There was another way.

"Big news! I just went to the bathroom, came back and saw a hot post on the forum."

"What news?"

"You guys remember the Blessing Necklace quest? After completing it, you don't get gold or equipment. Instead, you get an Abyss Map Teleport Scroll. Someone (a shill) discovered it by accident. This quest can only be done once per person per day!"

In other words, free-to-play players could get one free dungeon ticket every day by doing the quest.

This way, everyone could experience the dungeons, the F2P crowd wouldn't have as much resentment, and it could also entice them to top up.

"I'm going to find the Veteran and see what this teleport scroll is for."

Fu Guoqiang ran all the way and found the nearest Veteran to talk to.

The Veteran said, "Respected warrior, the power of the abyss is invading. Are you ready for an adventure? Every abyss map has powerful monsters, and also bountiful spoils... Remember, do not venture in alone!"

Fu Guoqiang glanced at the teleport links and found that the maps with bosses all had corresponding abyss dungeons.

The lowest level one, Abyss Woma Temple, only required one ticket to enter.

Higher-level abyss maps, however, required two, three, four... tickets.

Moreover, going in alone was suicide. You had to team up to fight the boss, which meant everyone had to contribute a ticket.

The Veteran also provided several email addresses and QQ numbers.

Needless to say, they were for contacting to top up.

In those days, you didn't need to request and get approval to add a friend on QQ.

Fu Guoqiang randomly added one of the QQ numbers and asked, "How much for one Abyss Teleport Scroll?"

The other party replied, "5 yuan. If you top up 50 yuan at once, you can get 12 Abyss Teleport Scrolls. How many do you want, big bro?"

Fu Guoqiang found this very interesting. He laughed and typed, "Send me your payment account, I'll top up 500 yuan to try it out first."

"Okay, please send your in-game ID. After confirming the payment is received, the teleport scrolls will be sent to you."

The first transaction for Abyss Legend was thus completed.

Fu Guoqiang looked at the Abyss Map Teleport Scrolls in his inventory and shouted in the party channel, "Everyone come to the Veteran, let's go do an abyss map together!"

"Damn, I can't even run, it's so laggy just getting into town."

"Brother Qiang, this game is unplayable."

"It's too laggy. I'm going to the forums to flame them. What kind of crappy private server is this!"

"Haha, even my Taoist can teleport instantly. It's so laggy I don't even know where I am."

"Lagging so bad I'm moonwalking. I'm Michael Jackson."

"..."

There were too many players, and the server for Zone 1 had finally crashed
